desc: This kit contains all the products and tools needed to clean and maintain weapons for optimal performance and reliability. 4 oz. M-Pro 7 gun cleaner, 2 oz. M-Pro 7 gun oil LPX, 2oz. M-Pro 7 copper remover. 50-cleaning patches (.38-.45 caliber), 1-non lint gun cloth, 1-gun rod. 5-Assorted bore brushes, 1-Utility brush, 1-Shot gun brush adapter, 1-.22 caliber loop, 1-foam gun pad, 1-lockable gun case, 1-M-Pro 7 Weapons maintenance & product guide.
